name: musiccraft
description: MusicCraft Studio DAW, Virtual Vocal Synthesizer, Stem Separator & Offline Mix Renderer (25 tools).

tools.name: musiccraft_status
tools.description: Inspect MusicCraft engine version, sample rate, and capabilities.

tools.name: musiccraft_project_new
tools.description: Create a new .mcraft song project with name, BPM, and musical key.

tools.name: musiccraft_project_open
tools.description: Load an existing .mcraft song project from disk.

tools.name: musiccraft_project_save
tools.description: Save the active song project to a .mcraft file.

tools.name: musiccraft_project_info
tools.description: Inspect song project metadata, track count, vocal line, and stems.

tools.name: musiccraft_track_add
tools.description: Add an audio, midi, vocal, or stem track to the song arrangement.

tools.name: musiccraft_track_list
tools.description: List all tracks and regions in the song project.

tools.name: musiccraft_track_set_mix
tools.description: Update track volume (dB), pan (-1..1), mute, or solo state.

tools.name: musiccraft_region_add
tools.description: Insert a new MIDI or audio region onto a track.

tools.name: musiccraft_region_split
tools.description: Split a timeline region into two regions at split_beat.

tools.name: musiccraft_region_move
tools.description: Move a timeline region to a new start beat.

tools.name: musiccraft_region_resize
tools.description: Resize a timeline region length in beats.

tools.name: musiccraft_region_duplicate
tools.description: Duplicate a timeline region immediately after its end beat.

tools.name: musiccraft_region_delete
tools.description: Delete a region from the arrangement.

tools.name: musiccraft_note_add
tools.description: Add a MIDI note to a region in the piano roll.

tools.name: musiccraft_note_remove
tools.description: Remove a MIDI note from a region by pitch and start beat.

tools.name: musiccraft_marker_add
tools.description: Add a named timeline marker at a beat position.

tools.name: musiccraft_track_add_fx
tools.description: Append a DSP effect (eq, compressor, delay, reverb) to a track FX rack.

tools.name: musiccraft_modify_quantize
tools.description: Snap MIDI note start beats to the nearest rhythmic grid.

tools.name: musiccraft_modify_transpose
tools.description: Transpose MIDI notes and optional vocal line by semitones (-48..48).

tools.name: musiccraft_vocal_synth
tools.description: Synthesize a virtual singer vocal line from phonemes (OPERA, SOPRANO, TENOR, CHOIR, SYNTH).

tools.name: musiccraft_stem_split
tools.description: Separate a WAV mix (or project demo mix) into 4 stems: vocals, drums, bass, other.

tools.name: musiccraft_mix_render
tools.description: Offline-render the song arrangement into a mastered 16-bit stereo WAV with LUFS telemetry.

tools.name: musiccraft_export_stems
tools.description: Export master mix, 4 stems, and handoff.json manifest for djcraft.

tools.name: musiccraft_export_song
tools.description: Export .mcraft project, master mix, stems, and handoff manifest into out_dir.
